sancocho.name: Sancocho
sancocho.description: A traditional Colombian stew: green banana thickens the broth and gives it body.
sancocho.imageAlt: Sancocho with pieces of green banana, cassava, corn on the cob and chicken.

cayeye.name: Cayeye
cayeye.description: Mashed green banana with costeño cheese and butter, typical of Magdalena.
cayeye.imageAlt: Green banana cayeye with costeño cheese and butter.

guineitos.name: Boiled or pickled guineítos
guineitos.description: Boil them until a fork goes in easily. They go well with fish or meat.
guineitos.imageAlt: Boiled guineítos with pickled onion and fried fish.

patacon.name: Green banana patacón
patacon.description: Flattened fried slices, smaller and softer than those made with hartón plantain.
patacon.imageAlt: Green banana patacones with hogao, a tomato and onion sauce.

chips-horneados.name: Baked chips
chips-horneados.description: Thin slices with oil and salt, baked in the oven.
